title: Ring-based Spatial Transformer: Learning Non-linear Spatial Interactions between Building Distribution and Pedestrian Flow
abstract: arXiv:2608.14660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study proposes a ring-based SpatialTransformer to learn how building uses at different distances from a railway station interact to generate pedestrian flow. Concentric ring buffers at 100-meter intervals up to 800 meters were defined around 100 randomly selected stations in Tokyo, treating each ring as a spatial token. Self-Attention was applied to learn inter-zone interactions directly from data, without prior structural assumptions. GPS-derived walking trip counts served as the target variable and Geographically Weighted Regression as the baseline. Across 30 independent trials, the SpatialTransformer consistently outperformed GWR in predictive accuracy. SHAP analysis revealed that mid-to-outer distance zone features dominate pedestrian flow prediction, while features from the 0-100m zone contributed little. translated_title: 基于环形的空间变换器：学习建筑分布与行人流量之间的非线性空间交互
translated_abstract: 本研究提出了一种基于环形的空间变换器（SpatialTransformer），用于学习火车站不同距离处建筑用途如何相互作用以产生行人流量。研究在东京随机选取的100个车站周围，定义了以100米为间隔、直至800米的同心环形缓冲区，并将每个环视为一个空间标记。应用自注意力机制直接从数据中学习区域间的交互，无需先验结构假设。以GPS推导的步行出行次数作为目标变量，地理加权回归（GWR）作为基线模型。在30次独立试验中，空间变换器在预测准确性上始终优于GWR。SHAP分析显示，中至外距离区域的特征主导行人流量预测，而0-100米区域的特征贡献甚微。注意力矩阵表明，每个距离区域最关注空间上较远的区域，从而证明了非线性空间交互的存在。
tldr: 本研究提出一种环形空间变换器，利用自注意力机制学习火车站周边不同距离建筑分布与行人流量的非线性交互，显著优于传统地理加权回归，并揭示中远距离区域对预测起主导作用。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a ring-based SpatialTransformer that uses self-attention to learn nonlinear spatial interactions between building distribution and pedestrian flow around stations, outperforming geographically weighted regression and revealing that mid-to-outer distance zones dominate prediction.
